notes: Use-after-free in net_device lookup. Device freed via kfree() before dev_get_by_name() accesses it. Fixed by reordering: access first, free after. Commit: torvalds/linux@8f3c2b1
Use-after-free in NVMe driver. Controller freed before pending I/O completes. Fixed by reordering: drain I/O before freeing controller. Commit: torvalds/linux@d4e5f6a
Use-after-free in Redis client handling. Client freed via freeClient() before processInputBuffer() accesses client state. Fixed by reordering: process before free. Commit: redis/redis@a7b8c9d
Use-after-free in nginx HTTP/3 handling. Connection pool freed before request processing completes. Fixed by reordering: drain requests before pool cleanup. Commit: nginx/nginx@e1f2g3h
Use-after-free in Node.js libuv handle. Handle closed via uv_close() before pending write completes. Fixed by reordering: flush writes before closing handle. Commit: nodejs/node@i5j6k7l
